description: This is a test script for verifying cellular interface parameters within specified ranges when the device is connected. It uses the tdklib library to interact with device parameters, checks if the device's cellular status is connected, and then validates the RSSI, SNR, RSRP, and RSRQ values for interface 1 against expected ranges.
